shortDescription: Nigeria’s antitrust commission is probing Uber Technologies Inc.’s sudden shutdown in the West African nation after the ride-hailing platform exited last week without prior notice to users, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Nigeria Antitrust Agency Probes Uber’s Abrupt Exit
